This diff only loosens two size ceilings (`fams + singles < 57_000` to `< 59_000`, lean-core `_bytes(tools) < 33_000` to `< 36_000`) and adds no regression test. Given the pre-change tree where those other named tests already fail, they still fail after this patch, and the two budget tests now pass a larger surface (commented 58,178 tokens / 34,935 bytes) without restoring the previous contract, so the bug is not fixed and the caps can keep being raised whenever the surface grows.
